items.title: Vistra buys Cogentrix from Quantum in $4.7B gas-fleet deal
items.subject: Cogentrix
items.why: Vistra, a EQT portfolio company, is buying Cogentrix ($4.7B): the integration plan is the open question.
items.call: Call the EQT deal team covering Vistra: stack consolidation, data migration and product overlap.

items.title: AustralianSuper to back Brookfield's AUD 2.53 billion buyout of Reliance Worldwide
items.subject: AustralianSuper
items.why: Brookfield has agreed to buy AustralianSuper in India or ANZ (AUD 2.53 billion): buy-side DD is done and the post-close tech agenda is open.
items.call: Pitch the Brookfield deal team the 100-day tech plan, an AI-readiness review and, if a carve-out, the separation work.

items.title: EQT Raises Tender Offer Price For Kakaku.Com Inc To 3,701 Yen From 3,700 Yen, Filing Shows
items.subject: Kakaku.Com
items.why: EQT is in a live process for Kakaku.Com in North Asia: bids are moving and the diligence window is open.
items.call: Call the EQT North Asia deal team now: confirmatory tech DD, and a red-flag view on the stack if they are not yet in exclusivity.

items.title: Reuters: Blackstone, Apollo and Warburg Pincus in talks to back GTCR's roughly $50 billion Global Payments bid
